选择 Skill 与专家团多选结果会以可见引用写入输入内容。browser-useSkillResearch and operate rendered web pages through OpenCorvus Browser tools, including authenticated workflows and visual inspection.computer-useSkillOperate native desktop apps through OpenCorvus Computer tools when the task requires their visible interface.design-taste-frontendSkillApply context-aware visual judgment to frontend product design and redesign work. Infer the design language from the accepted brief and evidence, use mature design systems, avoid generic generated-interface patterns, and finish through real rendered-page inspection.grill-meSkillGrill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.research-reportSkillProduce a multi-source research report — comparison matrix, capability survey, market analysis, recommendation document — backed by `websearch` (and `webfetch` only after `websearch` returns a concrete URL). Activate when the deliverable is a markdown report rather than running software, and the work is fundamentally synthesising prose from external sources rather than writing code. Signals — the brief asks for 报告 / 调研 / 对比 / 分析 / 综述 / 功能矩阵 / 评估 / 建议 / report / comparison / matrix / analysis / survey / recommendation; or compares named third-party products / platforms / vendors; or asks for a structured insight + recommendation document. Do NOT activate for code tasks, even when the code happens to consume third-party APIs.work-artifactsSkillCreate, inspect, validate, review, and deliver enabled structured Work Artifacts through the single OpenCorvus Work Artifact Harness. Use for presentation and other document, PDF, spreadsheet, data, image, archive, OCR, or media requests only when the mounted profile registry exposes that format. The current P0 profile creates new PPTX presentations with adapter-input isolation; it does not claim an operating-system network sandbox, edit existing presentations, or provide DOCX, XLSX, PDF, OCR, archive, image, data, or media production yet.generalMission SkillCoordinate an operator-defined Mission through native Mission state and fixed-profile Tasks without imposing a domain-specific workflow.专家团Advanced专家团 · advancedBuilt-in advanced software delivery team with capability-matched Requirements-to-Architect traceability, execution, testing, interface, and independent-review frontiers.Base专家团 · baseCompact outcome delivery through capability-matched execution and independent verification; planning and parallel research only when needed.Research Studio专家团 · research-studioA research planning, durable evidence collection, reproducible analysis, post-computation fact-checking, and template-driven report-delivery squad.Generate Expert Squads生成器专家团 · squad-sdkEvidence-led heterogeneous algorithm import and canonical generation of project-owned, traceable OpenCorvus Expert Squads with independent contract review.安装更多专家团Squad 市场浏览 Squad 市场，只安装当前项目需要的专家团。
